name: io.github.Crossave/crossave-dazi
title: Crossave import duty & VAT
description: EU import duty & VAT calculator (rules since 1 July 2026), real shop origins and shipping rates.

tools.name: calcola_costo_totale
tools.description: Work out the REAL cost of buying an item in one country and having it shipped to another: import duty, VAT or GST, and the final total. Figures are read from official tariff texts, not estimated. Returns `calcolabile: false` — with no numbers and a reason — for destinations whose rules are not modelled; never substitute a guess. Country codes are two-letter ISO (IT, US, JP, GB...). Call `elenco_categorie` if unsure which category to pass.

paese_partenza.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. IT, US, JP, GB.

paese_arrivo.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. IT, US, JP, GB.

prezzo.description: Price of the goods, excluding shipping.

venduto_su_marketplace.description: True if bought through a marketplace (eBay, Amazon...): under EU rules it often collects VAT at checkout, and it must not be charged twice.

prodotto.description: What the shopper is buying, in their own words. Always pass it when known: the answer then carries `confronta_su_crossave`, the live comparison of every store selling that item with duty and shipping in the total.

tools.name: spiega_regola
tools.description: Explain WHY a given category pays what it pays on a given route: the tariff heading, the rule behind the rate, and worked examples below and above the threshold that changes it. Use this when someone asks not just how much, but on what basis — or when you need to cite a source rather than assert a rate.

paese_partenza.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. IT, US, JP, GB.

paese_arrivo.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. IT, US, JP, GB.

tools.name: elenco_categorie
tools.description: List the goods categories accepted by the other tools. Call this before guessing a category value.

tools.name: sede_del_negozio
tools.description: Look up the country a named online store really ships from, read on an official page of that store (imprint, terms of sale, public company register) — never inferred from its name or domain, because that inference is wrong often enough to matter: GreaTecno has an Italian name and is Spanish, BecexTech has a .com.au domain and is from Hong Kong, Shop-Apotheke and DocMorris look German and are Dutch. Returns `sede_nota: false` when we have not read it — do not substitute a guess, because the origin country decides the duty.

negozio.description: The store as it appears to the shopper. Prefer the store's DOMAIN (e.g. wafuu.com, shop-apotheke.com, snipes.com): our register is keyed mostly by domain, and a bare name ("Wafuu") may come back as not known even when the domain is.

tools.name: costo_spedizione
tools.description: The delivery charge a named store PUBLISHES for a destination country and order value, read on the store's own delivery page. Distinguishes three different silences instead of returning zero: the store does not ship there at all (`spedisce_qui: false` — a fact, not a gap), the cost depends on the single item's size or weight and is only shown in the cart, or the store publishes only its free-shipping threshold and not the cost below it. `spedizione_nota: false` never means free.

negozio.description: The store. Prefer the store's DOMAIN (e.g. wafuu.com, shop-apotheke.com, snipes.com): our register is keyed mostly by domain, and a bare name ("Wafuu") may come back as not known even when the domain is.

paese_arrivo.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. IT, US, JP, GB.

valore_ordine.description: Value of the order, which decides free-shipping thresholds.

tools.name: costo_totale_dal_negozio
tools.description: The one question a price alone cannot answer: buying from a NAMED store, what lands at your door — the store's real shipping origin, its published delivery charge, import duty and VAT, and the final total. Prefer this over `calcola_costo_totale` whenever the shopper names a store, because it reads the origin instead of asking you to supply one. Since 1 July 2026 the EU's EUR 150 duty-free threshold is gone, so a listed price is now systematically incomplete on almost any parcel arriving from outside the EU. When shipping is not published the total is a FLOOR and says so.

negozio.description: The store. Prefer the store's DOMAIN (e.g. wafuu.com, shop-apotheke.com, snipes.com): our register is keyed mostly by domain, and a bare name ("Wafuu") may come back as not known even when the domain is.

tools.name: migliori_offerte
tools.description: Use this when the user asks where to buy an item or what it really costs delivered to Italy. Returns up to the 3 cheapest offers from real shops whose delivered total is CERTAIN (shipping, import duty, EU handling fee and VAT all known), each with a Crossave link to the offer, plus the link to all offers. Read-only, from the comparison Crossave already prepared: if none is ready it says so and gives the link to run it. Show the card; do not add estimates.

prodotto.description: The item, in the shopper's words, e.g. "Charizard ex 199/165".
